ANATOMY_HARD_RULES.added: 2026-07-11 creator directive after two-headed Bella reject and three-pigtail Mia defect
rules: Every character has EXACTLY ONE HEAD, correctly proportioned to their body — no exceptions, no duplicates, no merged bodies
Humans: exactly 2 arms, 2 legs, 5 fingers per hand. Dogs: exactly 4 legs, 1 tail
MIA: EXACTLY TWO low pigtails — never three, never one, never a different hairstyle
BELLA: ONE head, single body, proportionate — reject any render that deviates
Hair/accessory counts in each character's appearance block are EXACT counts, not suggestions
Every generated image with characters gets an anatomy inspection (heads, limbs, hair counts) BEFORE its video is generated; every batch gets a frame-level anatomy pass before assembly
Any render failing anatomy = REJECTED and regenerated; rejected candidates are deleted from staging immediately after review so they can never be mistaken for canon
